summary: Admin Paras Mall (/admin/mall) pagination + full delivery-address column enhancement verified end-to-end. Backend 9/9 pytest PASS: /api/admin/mall/bookings returns `delivery` sub-object with all required keys (name/mobile/address_line/landmark/city/state/pin_code) plus user_name+user_mobile, status filters work, no _id leak. Frontend E2E PASS: (a) admin login → /admin/mall renders admin-paras-mall; (b) Products paginator shows 'Page 1 / 4' for 48 products, prev/next/last-page-disabled all correct; (c) Bookings tab has new 'Delivery Address' column header; (d) All-Bookings sub-tab renders 25 rows on page 1 with 7 address cells (MapPin icon + phone + line + landmark + city+state + pin_code + copy button) and 18 'No Address Captured' warning badges — legacy rows correctly identified; (e) Bookings paginator shows 'Page 1 / 3' (56 rows / 25), next/prev works; (f) sub-tab switching (Pending → Delivered → back to All) resets page to 1 confirmed; (g) Copy button click surfaces 'Address copied to clipboard' toast; (h) Pipeline tab renders Kanban (Booked=43, Confirmed=0, Packed=1, Shipped=0, Delivered=1) with admin-pipeline-refresh functional, no pagination on pipeline (intentional).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminParasMall.js line 265-270: `[...].map(...).slice(0, 2)` renders only 2 of the 3 status tiles (mining, fulfilled — but NOT delivered). If the intent is to show all 3 status counts the .slice(0,2) is a bug; if the intent is to fit into 4 grid columns, the code is fine — clarify.

AdminParasMall.js line 131-166: The 3-query fan-out (fulfilled + delivered + recent) then in-JS merge+dedupe+re-sort keeps the client heavy for admins with 5k+ bookings. Consider a single server endpoint that already returns the sorted union, or a paged API using skip/limit at the DB layer. Current impl clients scale to ~10k rows before janking.

AdminParasMall.js line 91-98: `bookings.filter((b) => b.status === 'fulfilled')` runs on every render (not memoized). For 5k+ bookings this is fine but could be memoized to reduce React reconcile overhead when toggling sub-tabs. Low priority.

paras_mall.py line 1384: `admin_list_bookings` route has NO auth dependency in the visible signature — appears to rely on upstream router-level auth. Confirm the admin_router prefix carries a Depends(admin_only) middleware; otherwise this is IDOR risk (anyone with a token can list all bookings including delivery.address_line + mobile PII).

paras_mall.py line 1388: uses `limit=200` default with sort by created_at DESC. The frontend has to fan out into 3 calls with limit=500/500/300 as a workaround. Consider adding a `?tabs=fulfilled,delivered,recent` combined endpoint or increasing default limit to reduce roundtrips.

AdminParasMall.js Paginator component is defined at module scope — good; but it's re-imported inside AdminParasMall only. If any other admin page needs pagination consider moving to /components/ui/Paginator.js for reuse.

rca of the issue: Not a bug fix iteration — this is feature verification. Both features work as documented: (1) client-side pagination correctly slices lists with useMemo, gracefully hides paginator when totalPages<=1, resets bookings page on sub-tab change via useEffect on [bookingsTab], clamps page on list shrinkage; (2) full delivery address column renders MapPin+name / mobile with 📞 / address_line / optional Landmark line / city+state / pin_code (bold) — exactly matching the review spec. Copy button uses navigator.clipboard.writeText with fallback toast on error. Mark Delivered button correctly disables when !hasAddress (verified in code path via title tooltip differentiation).
